text.p: NARODNA OBRODA - Slovak defence minister Jan Sitek said it was neccessary for Slovakia to revive and develop its arms industry as soon as possible.
- The government holds its regular session on Tuesday. The preliminary agenda includes information on the further privatisation of state-run refrigerator producer Calex Zlate Moravce.
- The National Property Fund, the state's privatisation agency, has approved another 22 privatisation decisions whose total worth is around 640 million crowns.

- Some 110,934 orders to sell privatisation bonds have been registered on the over-the-counter RM-System since the beginning of trade on August 5. Only 1,550 bonds were sold in anonymous trade, while some 53,826 bonds were sold in direct trades.
HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar said next year's state budget would include two to three billion crowns to help Slovak agricultural firms to pay off part of their debts.

SME - More than 30 deputies, the required minimum, have already signed a proposal calling for an extraordinary session of parliament, with the only item on the agenda being the dismissal of agriculture minister Peter Baco for alleged corruption.
